notes: Balances tab works on the phone - each statement is a card instead of a 7-column table. Accounts cards show when each account was last imported and when its balance was last checked (amber when overdue). Budget page gets a month-close checklist: what is left to import, reconcile, file or match before a month is closed, and a green line once a past month is done. Settings -> Categories: 'rename' is now 'edit' - change the name, group and expense/income type in one place.
